title: Petrol Pump Automation with Dispenser Integration
excerpt: Connect compatible dispensers so live nozzle sales flow into daily closing without duplicate entry.
content:
Re-typing nozzle figures during a rush hour shift is where mistakes often start. Petroleu links compatible dispensers so live sales post directly to your station records.

Owners can compare dispenser totals with tank stock and cash collected before closing the day. If a nozzle total looks off, the variance shows up while staff are still on the forecourt.

Dispenser data stays tied to credit customers, dipping records, and financial reports — so automation supports your existing closing process rather than replacing it.
author: Petroleu

title: ATG Tank Monitoring for Fuel Stations
excerpt: See live tank levels with dip readings and nozzle sales to track gain, loss, and delivery timing.
content:
Tank stock affects every closing decision. Petroleu supports ATG monitoring so live tank levels appear next to dip readings and nozzle sales in one view.

When dipped stock and system stock do not match, the variance is visible before month-end reconciliation. Managers can plan deliveries and investigate gain or loss patterns from dated records.

ATG data works alongside Petroleu dipping reports and purchase entries, giving owners a clearer picture of what is inside each underground tank.
author: Petroleu

title: AI Reporting & Business Analysis for Petrol Pumps
excerpt: Sales, stock, receivables, and payables in exportable reports — with AI summaries for quicker review.
content:
Pump owners often need more than a daily sales total. Petroleu reporting brings nozzle performance, credit outstanding, tank variance, and supplier payables into structured reports you can export for your accountant.

AI-assisted summaries highlight patterns in daily closing, dip gain/loss, and credit recovery — so managers spend less time searching registers and more time reviewing what changed.

Whether you run one forecourt or several branches, the same report set helps you compare periods and share figures with partners or staff.
author: Petroleu

title: WhatsApp Invoices and Payment Reminders
excerpt: Share credit invoices and payment reminders on WhatsApp from the same ledger that records the sale.
content:
Fleet and corporate credit customers expect quick billing. Petroleu lets your team send invoice details and payment reminders on WhatsApp without copying figures from a separate register.

When a customer disputes an amount, staff can pull the linked ledger entry and vehicle-wise fill history in the same system. That shortens follow-up calls and keeps collection records dated.

WhatsApp messaging works alongside credit limits, vehicle-wise accounts, and daily closing — so billing stays part of your accounts workflow.
author: Petroleu

title: Multi-Station Fuel Network Management
excerpt: Review sales, stock, and daily closing across multiple petrol pumps from one owner dashboard.
content:
Running two or more stations means collecting figures from different forecourts every night. Petroleu gives head office branch-wise sales, stock, and closing reports without manual consolidation.

Compare receivables by location, check which branch had a dip loss this week, and confirm each site followed the same shift closing steps. Site managers keep local control while owners see the full network picture.

Multi-station management suits operators growing from a single pump to a regional fuel group.
author: Petroleu

title: Daily Closing and Shift Management
excerpt: Close each shift with nozzle totals, cash and credit splits, dipping records, and a reconciled day report.
content:
Night closing falls apart when nozzle totals, cash in hand, and credit charges come from different notebooks. Petroleu records readings, cash sales, credit sales, and dip entries in one shift workflow.

Supervisors reconcile totals before sign-off and can reopen a previous closing if a cash difference needs investigation. The daily report matches what owners expect to hand their accountant.

Structured shift closing means less rework at month-end and fewer surprises when reviewing staff cash responsibility.
author: Petroleu

title: Credit Customer and Vehicle-Wise Billing
excerpt: Credit limits, vehicle-wise fills, outstanding balances, and monthly billing in one customer ledger.
content:
Credit sales are common at Pakistani pumps, but manual registers make outstanding balances hard to track. Petroleu records each fill by customer and vehicle, checks limits before dispensing, and keeps a dated payment history.

When month-end arrives, staff can print or share statements showing opening balance, new charges, and receipts. Owners see who owes what without adding up separate notebooks.

Vehicle-wise billing reduces disputes with fleet customers and makes collection follow-up more straightforward.
author: Petroleu

title: Tank Dipping and Stock Gain/Loss Reports
excerpt: Link dip readings with nozzle sales and deliveries to spot gain, loss, and stock gaps early.
content:
A dip reading only helps if you compare it with book stock and nozzle sales. Petroleu ties dipping records to delivery entries and dispenser totals so gain and loss show up in dated reports.

If petrol stock drops faster than sales suggest, managers can review the variance that week instead of finding the gap at month-end. Regular dipping reports support daily stock discipline on busy forecourts.

Used with ATG monitoring or manual dips, Petroleu stock reports give owners a practical view of what is inside each tank.
author: Petroleu

title: Cloud-Based Petrol Pump Management
excerpt: Access sales, stock, and closing reports from the forecourt, office, or mobile app with cloud backups.
content:
Owners are not always on the forecourt when a cash difference or stock issue needs attention. Petroleu stores station data in the cloud so sales, credit outstanding, and closing reports are available from desktop or mobile.

Automatic backups reduce the risk of losing readings and closings if a local PC fails. Managers can review yesterday's closing from home or check a second branch while travelling.

Cloud access suits growing pumps that add staff, shifts, or branches and need records available beyond a single on-site computer.
